title: xpeek configuration
description: Screen text capture, OCR, translation, and popup settings. Saved regions and popup geometry belong in state files.

$schema.description: Schema URL or path for editor validation; ignored by xpeek.

history_limit.description: Maximum number of saved translation history entries.

provider.description: Default translation provider; clipboard copies original OCR text.

source_lang.description: Source translation language; auto or detect requests detection. Supported codes depend on the provider, independently of OCR models.

target_lang.description: Target translation language code supported by the provider.

persistent_window.description: Start new popups in append mode, retaining the latest 10 translations with scrolling.

ocr_keepalive_seconds.description: Keep the popup process and loaded OCR models alive for this many idle seconds after closing. Reopening cancels the countdown; the next close restarts it. Visible popups and active work prevent expiry. Zero exits as soon as the popup closes and active work finishes. Clipboard-only calls remain independent.

ocr_engine.description: Default installed OCR engine. Setup chooses tiny, then RapidOCR, then small among installed engines for a new config.

ocr_options.description: Capture and preprocessing settings selected together with each OCR engine.

provider_options.description: Per-provider settings. Keep API keys in environment variables or .env when sharing configuration.

google.description: Google Translate needs no provider options or API key.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible API endpoint; null uses the SDK default.

num_gpu.description: Ollama GPU-layer setting; 0 uses CPU and null leaves the server default.

apiKey.description: Optional API key override. Keep empty or null to use the provider's environment variable.

capture_backend.description: Desktop captures the displayed region; gamescope captures native pixels on supported niri layouts, falling back to desktop with a terminal warning.

threads.description: Inference thread limit, not an OS CPU quota.

scale.description: Resize factor applied after capture; 1 keeps original size, 0.5 halves width and height.

preprocess.description: Keep color or convert to grayscale after resizing.
